bull.b: FDA feedback that CNM-Au8 data may support an accelerated-approval NDA is a structural milestone: acceptance of a surrogate endpoint (neurofilament light) could shorten time to market and de-risk later-stage investment needs, materially improving the commercial pathway if substantiated.

Pushing principal and interest to 2027 materially eases near-term liquidity pressure, giving management runway to advance the NDA and prepare Phase 3. This structural liability management reduces imminent refinancing risk and aligns cash outflows with expected regulatory milestones.

The $7M offering provides immediate non-debt capital to fund NDA prep, expanded access and Phase 3 setup. Fresh equity reduces short-term default risk and, combined with other amendments, extends the company’s ability to execute pivotal regulatory milestones without solely relying on new debt.

bear.b: Revenue remains negligible and has contracted, reflecting lack of commercialized products. This structural absence of operational revenue means the company cannot self-fund development, increasing persistent dependency on capital markets and strategic partners to sustain R&D and commercialization paths.

Sustained negative operating and free cash flow indicates structural cash consumption to support trials and operations. Continued burn necessitates recurring financings, heightening dilution and execution risk if fundraising conditions deteriorate before regulatory or clinical de‑risking events occur.

Negative shareholders' equity combined with meaningful debt reduces financial flexibility and may limit strategic options. Structural balance-sheet weakness raises refinancing and covenant risks, potentially increasing financing costs or forcing dilutive transactions ahead of pivotal clinical or regulatory outcomes.
